Legenda original:
This Veterans Day, we pause to recognize and honor all who have served and the sacrifices veterans and their families make. We are grateful for the many ways they continue to contribute to their communities.

Today, we also remember Tomas Young, who was wounded and paralyzed while serving in Iraq. In the years that followed, Tomas became a passionate advocate for peace and justice. We continue to honor his life and legacy through the Tomas Young Scholarship, supporting veterans and their families in pursuing higher education.

📸: Kevin Mazur
